Search the [existing frontend issues](https://github.com/DMedina559/bsm-frontend/issues)
before opening a report. This repository covers the web interface, JavaScript
packages, and the Python frontend distribution. Backend-only problems belong in
[bedrock-server-manager](https://github.com/DMedina559/bedrock-server-manager/issues).
